title: An efficient device selection and resource allocation method based on federated learning
assignee: Chongqing University of Post and Telecommunications

pse.problem: Excessive communication overhead in federated learning process due to too many parameter transmissions in a centralized manner, resulting in high communication overhead on the backbone network.
pse.solution_function: The invention presents an efficient device selection and resource allocation method based on federated learning. It reduces communication overhead by selecting devices participating in the federated learning and optimizing resource allocation. The main functions include parameter initialization, off-policy experience sampling, parameter update, and target network update.
pse.solution_structure: The key components are actor and critic networks for all edge agents, an experience replay pool with certain memory capacity, and a target network for each agent.
pse.solution_implementation: The system initializes parameters, adopts off-policy technology based on experience replay technology to sample experiences, coordinates edge agents to update parameters, and updates the target network using the updated parameters. The parameter update phase involves alternately updating between the experience gathered from all individual environments and the current agent's policy.
pse.effect: The method reduces communication overhead by reducing communication frequency and the total number of bits uploaded in a single round of communication.
